method_paragraph_lane: H78-FW is a catalogue-blind unsupervised surface on the pinned 19-band stack: detrend det_elev by subtracting its sigma=30 px Gaussian background; compute the rotation-invariant wide-scale curvature magnitude max(|l1|,|l2|) of the residual Hessian at sigma=8 px (~800 m) as the warp score; compute Gaussian gradient magnitudes of rtp and iso_grav_anom at sigma=3 px (300 m) as the central-step score (geometric mean); robustly normalize each component by its within-footprint 90th percentile capped to [0,1]; composite = sqrt(warp_n * central_n), zeros outside the footprint. No catalogue input, no learner, no tuning. Emission is the existing greedy >=2.8 px packing with the <=3 px visible-catalogue flank removed (B3), exactly 44,090 dots. Nothing else may change between holdout and production except the catalogue used for the flank mask (visible vs full).
hypothesis: Buried normal-fault tips produce distributed monoclinal flank warping hundreds of metres wide with a persistent basement/magnetic step at the centre, even where no narrow surface rupture exists for 1:250k compilations or narrow (sigma<=300 m) detectors; a wide-scale detrended curvature magnitude corroborated by a central 300 m potential-field step therefore places kernel credit on withheld fault segments that narrow supervised filters miss.
mechanism: Local planar detrending removes basin relief; the 800 m Hessian eigenvalue magnitude responds to broad antisymmetric flexure above a blind tip; the geometric mean with the 300 m RTP+gravity gradient product requires an independently observed subsurface discontinuity at the warp axis, suppressing purely topographic flexure. Catalogue-blindness guarantees the signal cannot be a catalogue-halo artefact.
named_non_fault_mimic: Differential sediment compaction across a basin margin (broad warp plus a real density step with no fault); secondarily buried lava-flow/sill edges.
why_missing_not_catalogued: USGS/INGENIOUS compilations require a mappable surface break; a blind tip with <5 m distributed warp and intrabasin cover falls below that threshold while retaining a basement step in magnetics/gravity. The surface uses no catalogue geometry at all, so it cannot be paid to crowd mapped traces.
differs_from_repo_prior: H78-A: supervised HGB on pointwise sigma=1.5/3 px steered/iso derivatives (catalogue orientation). H78-MPC: supervised LOQO HGB on pointwise monogenic phase congruency sigma<=4 px + Frangi. H78-CS: H78-A plus along-strike path integrals (same lane family, duplicated). H78-SPY: spy-cleaned H78-A refit (duplicated). H78-TOOTH: catalogue spacing prior (collapsed). H78-CROSSLAYER: unsupervised sigma=3 px unsigned gradient-normal alignment of RTP/gravity/depth with no detrending and no wide scale. FW is the only wide-scale (800 m) detrended-curvature plus central-step composite, unsupervised and catalogue-blind.
